title: Triple Path Turmoil
next_chapter_hook: When three distinctly different forces simultaneously extended their olive branches to him, Chen Ji finally perceived the chessboard that had loomed over him for twenty years—and the identity of the chess player was far more terrifying than he could have imagined.

text.content: When the blood-colored curtain of truth was lifted, revealing the identity of the executor of the blood-soaked finale after seven hundred chapters, a glimpse of its ferocious nature finally emerged—and in the instant Chen Ji locked eyes with Chen Tianming, the chessboard of destiny had already flipped.

Chen Ji slowly withdrew his gaze, the coldness buried deep in his eyes concealed beneath a perfectly calibrated facade of timidity. He was fully aware that his lingering glance with Chen Tianming had not escaped the notice of those present. Yet what did it matter? Deciphering an opponent's hidden strategies was precisely his forte. Ling Yuan's seat now sat empty—the cunning old fox had departed unnoticed. Chen Ji filed this observation away, his mind already unraveling the profound implications concealed within this seemingly simple maneuver.

dialogue.content: (Gently tugging at his sleeve, as if frightened by the previous scene, taking a half step backward)

text.content: Yet just then, a jet-black fissure tore open across the horizon. Demonic energy surged forth like a tide, yet harmlessly. Everyone's complexion changed dramatically as a blood-red throne slowly descended from the crack. Upon it sat a woman of breathtaking beauty—the Holy Sect Saint of the Demonic Path, Ye Qing. Her profoundly deep eyes swept past the crowd, fixing directly upon Chen Ji, her lips curving into a meaningful smile.

dialogue.content: The orphaned scion of the Chen family, this One has awaited you for eons. The karmic debts spanning ten thousand years demand a final resolution today.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart contracted sharply. The Chen family from ten thousand years ago? According to the Tianqing Sect's archives, his family background was merely that of a declining minor clan—when had he become entangled with a Demonic Sect Saint? Ye Qing's unwavering certainty did not appear fabricated, which meant his understanding of his own origins remained profoundly insufficient. Yet on the surface, he displayed only bewilderment, his lips trembling slightly as if rendered speechless by this sudden upheaval.

dialogue.content: (A cold laugh, arms crossed) Trash, you've stumbled into quite the fortunate encounter. Women seem to find you wherever you go. But tell me, demonic witch, are you certain this is the one you seek? Don't tell me you've been deceived by this waste's pretty face!

text.content: Ye Qing didn't even spare him a glance. Her delicate fingers pointed lightly, and a wisp of demonic energy wound sinuously around Han Lie's ankle. Han Lie's expression transformed instantly—he discovered he could not move a single inch, the Laws contained within that demonic energy far exceeding his comprehension.

dialogue.content: This One shares some old acquaintanceship with your clan's ancestor. Today, this One shall not make things difficult for you. Continue showing disrespect toward this One's honored guest, and these legs need not remain.

text.content: Han Lie's face flushed crimson, veins bulging at his temples, yet the demonic pressure rendered him utterly incapable of speech. The foremost prodigy of the Xuanwu Sect couldn't withstand a single exchange before Ye Qing—this scene chilled everyone present to their marrow. Chen Ji silently cataloged this moment: the Holy Sect Saint's power was indeed unfathomable. What could the Chen family's connection from ten thousand years ago truly signify?

dialogue.content: (Voice barely a whisper, yet precisely audible to those nearby) My lady Saint... this humble one was bitten by a snake as a child. Upon encountering someone of your caliber, my legs turn to jelly... Might I ask what brings you to this humble one? This one truly is merely a floor-sweeper at the Tianqing Sect...

choice.prompt: Demonic Holy Sect Saint Ye Qing publicly declares Chen Ji her 'Honored Guest'—is the ten-thousand-year-old connection between the Chen family and the Demonic Path a blessing or a curse?

choices.description: Leverage Ye Qing's intimidating presence to awe those present, while simultaneously probing the true relationship between the ancient Chen family and the Demonic Path. A towering tree invites the wind, but sometimes the wind is borrowed.
choices.visible_cost: Be spurned by the righteous path
choices.visible_reward: Gain the protection of a demonic faction, and discover clues to the mystery of one's origins
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's true intentions remain unclear, possibly constituting an even deeper chess game

text.content: Chen Ji's body trembled violently, yet like a drowning man grasping at a lifeline, he stumbled two steps toward Ye Qing. His performance was impeccable—that contradictory sensation of wanting to approach yet fearing to, ensured no one would suspect him of being anything other than a helpless wretch.

choices.description: Neither actively approach nor directly refuse—use more subtle methods to probe Ye Qing's hidden cards. Those of the Demonic Path who offer unsolicited kindness surely harbor ulterior motives.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve independent judgment,不被任何势力裹挟
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may thus lose patience

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, appearing as if he had been scared silly, standing frozen in place without moving a single step. His peripheral vision swept across Ye Qing, Han Lie, and the empty spot where Ling Yuan should have been, his mind rapidly calculating the intentions of these three factions.

However, before Ye Qing could speak, another异变 occurred in the heavens. A streak of golden light tore through the clouds, carrying an overwhelming imperialdignified. A messenger adorned in dragon-patterned brocade robes arrived through the air, holding in his hand a token emanating an ancient aura—on the token was carved a rune Chen Ji had never seen before, yet theimposing it contained made his pupils contract sharply.

dialogue.content: (His pupils slightly contracted, waves raging in his heart) Is that... a法则 fluctuation surpassing the Heavenly Dao? This small token actually contains power that even the Tianji Record cannot deduce?

text.content: The imperial messenger's gaze swept across everyone present, finally landing on Chen Ji, and he smiled faintly. There was no hostility in that smile, but rather acomposed of a predator examining prey.

dialogue.content: (The messenger's voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears) By order of the Heavenly Dao, bearing the Tianji Token, I invite Young Master Chen Ji to the Imperial Capital for a discussion.

text.content: Order of the Heavenly Dao? Tianji Token? Chen Ji felt a chill run down his spine. The name Tianji Record, he had never mentioned to anyone—how did this imperial messenger know? Moreover, the aura emanating from that token was clearly of the same origin as the Tianji Record—yet even more pure, even more ancient. A solemn gleam flashed in Ye Qing's eyes, clearly recognizing the token's origin.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's voice suddenly turned cold) The reach of the Eye of Heavenly Dao extends quite far. So this Tianji Token, this one thought it was some treasure, turns out to be nothing more than a trick left over from that old thing.

text.content: The imperial messenger was not angered by this, merely gently shaking the token in his hand. That Tianji Token suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light, and in an instant, heaven and earth lost their colors. Even Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist was pressed back step by step. Everyone felt as if an invisible giant hand was pressing down on their crown chakra—that was power surpassing all—the Heavenly Dao itself.

Ye Qing's expression finally changed. She rose abruptly, demonic energy surging forth, yet under the Tianji Token's light it melted like残雪 meeting the scorching sun. Between her and the Eye of Heavenly Dao, there clearly existed unknown grievances.

dialogue.content: (Voice pressed extremely low, yet carrying unquestionable warning) Chen Ji, this one only says one thing—once you step into the Imperial Capital, there is no turning back. The blood debt between the Chen family and the Heavenly Dao from ten thousand years ago, this one can help you recover, but you must come with this one.

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path and the imperial court simultaneously extended the olive branch. One side held the stakes of ten thousand years of ties and conspiracy; the other displayed a token surpassing the Heavenly Dao. And what was even more strange—why did the Eye of Heavenly Dao personally intervene?

choices.description: Since the Tianji Token and the Tianji Record share the same origin, perhaps the imperial court holds the key to completing the Tianji Record. Since the Eye of Heavenly Dao has come knocking actively, it shows he has already regarded himself as a chess piece—then follow his chess path and see who reveals a flaw first.
choices.visible_reward: Approach the truth of the Tianji Record, possibly obtain clues surpassing the Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: Deep into enemy territory, variables are extremely large

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, as if making a tremendous decision. He took a difficult step toward the imperial messenger, that thin back in the eyes of Ye Qing and Han Lie and others, no different from a foolish lamb throwing itself into a net.

choices.description: Since Ye Qing knew about the blood debt between the Chen family and the Heavenly Dao from ten thousand years ago, it shows she possessed far more intelligence than the imperial court. Between the enemy's enemy and a more powerful enemy, he chose to temporarily ally with the relatively more controllable force.
choices.visible_cost: Be regarded by the righteous path as remnant evil of the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the secret history of the Chen family from ten thousand years ago, the Demonic Path mist can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path is equally with ulterior motives, and has old grievances with the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.process_label: step back, show willingness to follow

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, then abruptly turned and ran toward Ye Qing. His acting was impeccable—that expression of being forced into a corner, with no care left to preserve, caused a gleam of amusement to flash in the imperial messenger's eyes.

Just as the two sides were at a stalemate, a laughter, aged yet full of vitality, came from the heavens. Everyone looked toward the source, and saw Ling Yuan's figure slowly emerge from the void—and what left everyone dumbfounded, this old Sect Master of the Tianqing Sect actually flew directly toward Chen Ji, and without warning, knelt on one knee.

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan's voice was aged yet carried a barely perceptible tremor) This old man Ling Yuan, bows to meet the Young Master of the Chen family. A thousand-year layout, today finally awaits the master's return.

text.content: This single kneel sent shock through the entire arena. Han Lie's eyes widened as if he'd seen a ghost; a flash of insight flickered in Ye Qing's eyes, as if understanding something; the Imperial Court envoy's expression finally shifted, the Heavenly Secrets Token in his hand dimming slightly as if reassessing the current situation. As for Chen Ji himself, his heart seemed to skip a beat—and then stop completely—Ling Yuan, the old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, that old fox who had been "taking good care" of him from the very beginning, had actually torn off his mask at this moment.

Chen Ji's mind raced through countless images. The ancient book Ling Yuan had "coincidentally" given him upon his entry into the sect, the elixir that had "happened" to appear when his cultivation hit a bottleneck, the helping hand that had "timely" arrived during each life-threatening crisis—it turned out he had been a piece on the chessboard from the very beginning. And now, the chess player knelt before him, speaking those four words: "A thousand-year scheme."

dialogue.content: (Voice slightly trembling, yet trying to maintain composure) Ling... Ling Sect Master, what do you mean by this? I am merely atrash, how could I possibly...

(Ling Yuan raised his head, his turbid old eyes actually glistening with tears) Young Master, please don't sell yourself short. This old man has waited for this day for three hundred years. Three hundred years ago, on the day the Tianji Record chose its master, this old man witnessed the fragment fall into the hands of the Chen family's ancestor, and knew that the Chen bloodline was the true master of the Tianji Record. This old man has been scheming until now, only waiting for Young Master to grow, awaken, and reclaim the Heavenly Secrets!

text.content: Chen Ji felt a chill run down his spine. Three hundred years? Ling Yuan had been scheming for three hundred years? So from the very beginning, when Tianqing Sect took him in, nurtured him, and even allowed Han Lie and others to bully him, it was all for this moment? His mind raced rapidly—the aura of the Tianji Record fragment, his Chen family bloodline, even the existence of Chen Nian—how many secrets had Ling Yuan already seen through?

What made his back even colder was that Ling Yuan chose to reveal his identity at this moment, which surely held deep meaning. Kneeling in loyalty before the Demonic Path Saint, the Imperial Court envoy, and everyone present—was this a declaration of war against someone, or a declaration of loyalty to someone? Chen Ji suddenly realized that perhaps from beginning to end, he was not the only one scheming—he was being schemed against by countless people simultaneously, and these people seemed to have intricate connections between them.

dialogue.content: (Han Lie finally came back to his senses from the shock, his eyes bloodshot) Crazy! Everyone's gone crazy! Just atrash, and all of you are... Old Ling, have you lost your mind? Three hundred years of scheming, just to kneel before a sweeper?

text.content: Ling Yuan didn't even lift his eyelids, merely glancing at Han Lie calmly. There was no emotion in that gaze, yet it made Han Lie feel as if he'd fallen into an ice pit—that was the gaze one reserves for ants, the gaze one reserves for the dead.

choice.prompt: Three major forces stepped forward simultaneously: the Demonic Path Saint threw out a connection from ten thousand years ago, the Imperial Court envoy displayed the Heavenly Dao Token, and the old Sect Master knelt on one knee to pledge loyalty. How should Chen Ji respond to this sudden "being pledged loyalty to"?

choices.description: Ling Yuan's sudden loyalty was far too suspicious—a man who had been scheming for three hundred years must have backup plans. First, feign acceptance, observe the reactions of all parties, find their hidden cards and weaknesses, then strike them down one by one.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to quickly gain intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the initiative,不被 any force coerced
choices.risk_hint: The three forces might jointly apply pressure

text.content: Chen Ji slowly reached out his hand, supporting Ling Yuan's arm. His movement was light and slow, yet it made everyone present feel an inexplicable pressure—the composure of a controller. A flash of gratification appeared in Ling Yuan's eyes; Young Master's steadiness far exceeded his expectations.

choices.description: Since all three parties wanted to recruit him, he would go with the flow. Let Ling Yuan, Ye Qing, and the Imperial Court envoy check and balance each other, while he sits back and profits. But this meant completely exposing his ambitions, letting everyone know thattrash Chen Ji was no ordinary person.
choices.visible_reward: The three forces check and balance each other, gaining maximum room for maneuvering
choices.risk_hint: Become the target of all, all forces will be doubly vigilant

text.content: Chen Ji slowly straightened up, the mask of cowardice quietly crumbling. His gaze became deep and serene, as if seeing through something, or as if having made some decision. Ye Qing, Han Lie, even Ling Yuan—all felt a change in that moment—trash Chen Ji seemed to no longer be a chess piece that could be easily manipulated.

But just at this moment, the Tianji Record fragment in Chen Ji's embrace suddenly vibrated violently. An unprecedented sense of crisis surged like a tide, his pupils constricting sharply—the Tianji Record was warning him! This meant that among the three forces before him, at least one had behind it that terrifying existence he had never met—Heavenly Dao's Eye!

Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the great waves in his heart. He suddenly smiled—that smile was faint, very light, yet it made everyone present feel a chill. Thattrash Chen Ji, the servant disciple who always kept his head down, hunched his shoulders, and never dared to fight back when bullied—at this moment, his smile actually made this fearless brute Han Lie step back involuntarily.

dialogue.content: (Voice terrifyingly calm) Since everyone here wishes to recruit Chen Ji, then Chen Ji dares to ask—does the one behind you know that you are fighting over me here?

text.content: The moment these words fell, the entire arena fell into dead silence. A flash of wariness crossed Ye Qing's eyes, Ling Yuan's expression froze for an instant, the Imperial Court envoy's pupils constricted sharply—they were all desperately hiding something, yet Chen Ji saw through it all. Three forces, three reactions, not one could remain completely calm. What did this mean? The tendrils of the Heavenly Dao's Eye extended far longer and deeper than he had imagined.

Chen Ji raised his head, gazing at the Heavenly Secrets Token still radiating golden light. He suddenly remembered something Mo Xiansheng had once said—"The Tianji Record is merely one of the many pieces Heaven has placed upon the mortal board." At the time, he thought it was merely a metaphor, but now the weight of those words proved far heavier than he could have imagined. He, Chen Ji, perhaps from the very moment of his birth, had been arranged for by some terrifying existence.

Just then, an aged yet familiar voice rang out in his mind—it was Mo Xiansheng's voice, carrying traces of both praise and worry: "Young master, you have finally awakened. But this is merely the tip of the iceberg; the true chessboard is far larger than you can imagine." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly, as if wishing to say more, yet forcibly restraining itself, "Some truths you are still unable to bear. But there is one thing I can tell you—Ling Yuan's loyalty is real, Ye Qing's origins are real, and the imperial token is real. But the black hand behind them all is the same."

Chen Ji's heart sank. Mo Xiansheng's words confirmed his worst suspicions—the three factions, though appearing utterly incompatible, were all pieces of Heaven's Eye. And he, the "chosen master of the Tianji Record," had from the very beginning been walking along preset trajectories on that terrifying existence's chessboard. Anger, humiliation, unwillingness—various emotions churned in his chest, yet Chen Ji forcibly suppressed them. He recorded everything, filing it all away. Someday, he would completely erase this幕后黑手 from the chessboard.

However, at this moment, he had to make a choice. The three factions watched with hungry eyes, the Tianji Record's warnings still echoed in his mind, and the brutal truth that he had always been a piece had driven him into a corner. Chen Ji slowly surveyed the crowd, the corner of his lips curving into a profound arc. Since all were pieces, he would become the one to overturn the entire chessboard!

dialogue.content: (His voice calm, yet carrying undeniable authority) Everyone's kindness, Chen receives it. But Chen has one rule—never serving beneath others. If you wish to cooperate with me, you must follow my commands. Otherwise, today's matter ends here.

text.content: These words fell, causing an uproar throughout the arena. Han Lie almost thought he had misheard—thistrash, actually dared to say "follow my commands" before the Demon Path Saint, the Imperial Envoy, and the Tianqing Sect's old Master? Yet what left him even more dumbfounded was that Ling Yuan stood up first, a relieved smile appearing on his aged face.

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan's voice trembled slightly, but with excitement rather than anger) This old one has waited three hundred years for this day. Young master's ambition brings this old one great comfort. From now on, the entire Tianqing Sect shall follow Young master's commands!

text.content: Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed softly. Her laughter was clear as silver bells, yet carried profound meaning—that was appreciation, and also recognition. The Holy Sect's demonic saintess had, at this moment, cast a truly equal gaze upon this humantrash.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's smile deepened) Interesting, this seat grows more and more expectant. Very well, Chen Ji, this seat agrees to you. But let ugly words come first—if one day you disappoint this seat, this seat's demonic blade will show no mercy.

text.content: Only the Imperial Envoy's face grewgloomy. The Heavenly Secrets Token in his hand trembled violently, as if sensing something. The Heavenly Dao laws contained within that token were issuing a warning—Chen Ji's existence had begun to shake the chessboard arranged by Heaven's Eye. This was something the Imperial Dynasty did not wish to see, yet it precisely proved Chen Ji's value.

Chen Ji met the Imperial Envoy's gaze, his eyes completely without fear. He slowly spoke, his voice light yet clearly entering each person's ears: "Go back and tell your master—this piece of Chen's, he can no longer place." The Imperial Envoy's pupils contracted sharply, and the Heavenly Secrets Token's light actually fluctuated violently at this moment—it was the Heavenly Dao itself, reacting to Chen Ji's words.

When the bloody curtain of truth was torn open, the identity of the one who would execute the bloody finale seven hundred chapters later finally revealed a terrifying glimpse—and in the instant Chen Ji and Chen Tianming gazed at each other, the chessboard of fate had already been overturned.
